types.reason: Same event as the 2025 and 2026 IronKids Phú Quốc, so same series. City Phú Quốc (the ActiUp venue is Phú Quốc). https://irace.vn/su-kien/ironkids-viet-nam/ (iRace page for 'Giải IRONKIDS Việt Nam diễn ra vào ngày 16 tháng 11 năm 2024'): aquathlon and triathlon; ages 5-10 swim 75m + run 1km (+3km bike for triathlon), ages 11-15 double: 150m + 2km (+6km bike). Course meters are the sum of the legs; ages have no field and stay here (1075m/4075m are 5-10, 2150m/8150m are 11-15). That page dates the race 16/11/2024 while ActiUp says 15-16/11; the date is not changed.
